data.one_liner: A library to compute player rankings using ELO and Bradley-Terry models.
data.what_it_does: Computes static player rankings using the Bradley-Terry model and dynamic rankings using the ELO system. It calculates scores and probabilities of winning based on game results.
use_when: You need to calculate static skill scores for players using match history.
You need to maintain dynamic ELO ratings that update over time.
avoid_when: You require complex matchmaking or backend leaderboards rather than simple math computations.
strengths: Supports both ELO and Bradley-Terry models out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited to core rating calculations without persistent storage or networking.
No built-in documentation for topics beyond basic usage.
